entry.title: Research Summary: August 24, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research highlights advances in AI safety evaluation and behavioral reliability, led by interpretability, clinical reasoning, and robotics contributions. Open-weight masked introspection delivers a rigorous null-condition negative result challenging claims that models can report on their own computation, while CLEAR introduces hidden-state gated safety adapters to ease the safety–utility tradeoff.

  • Behavioral safety: Affective context systematically amplifies sycophancy; therapy bots misread hyperbolic youth communication in mental-health contexts; representational occupational bias persists even when behavioral tests pass
  • Domain benchmarks: VIALS exposes visual interpretation gaps on authentic biotech artifacts (gel blots, microscopy); a ten-move therapeutic ontology validated by licensed psychologists enables steering of LLM psychotherapy
  • Systems and scale: The Muon optimizer shows persistent advantages over AdamW on diffusion transformers up to 15B parameters; delegated exposure measures actual worker-to-AI task commitment across 53,000 configurations
  • Robotics safety: Logic-VLA conditions policies on temporal logic specifications at inference time; clinical work characterizes lost-in-the-middle retrieval failures across six models on EHR processing
entry.content:
Today's research highlights advances in AI safety evaluation and behavioral reliability, led by interpretability, clinical reasoning, and robotics contributions. Open-weight masked introspection delivers a rigorous null-condition negative result challenging claims that models can report on their own computation, while CLEAR introduces hidden-state gated safety adapters to ease the safety–utility tradeoff.

  • Behavioral safety: Affective context systematically amplifies sycophancy; therapy bots misread hyperbolic youth communication in mental-health contexts; representational occupational bias persists even when behavioral tests pass
  • Domain benchmarks: VIALS exposes visual interpretation gaps on authentic biotech artifacts (gel blots, microscopy); a ten-move therapeutic ontology validated by licensed psychologists enables steering of LLM psychotherapy
  • Systems and scale: The Muon optimizer shows persistent advantages over AdamW on diffusion transformers up to 15B parameters; delegated exposure measures actual worker-to-AI task commitment across 53,000 configurations
  • Robotics safety: Logic-VLA conditions policies on temporal logic specifications at inference time; clinical work characterizes lost-in-the-middle retrieval failures across six models on EHR processing

entry.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

author.name: Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Tests whether eight open-weight models can introspect about their own computation using OWMI, which intervenes on residual streams, attention heads, and SAE features then interrogates the model against sham and impact-matched controls. None of the models answered better than chance, contradicting recent claims of capable self-auditing.

entry.title: VIALS: A Benchmark for Visual Interpretation of Artifacts in the Life Sciences

author.name: Elaine Lau, Thanuka Udumulla, Lee Izhaki-Tavor, Francisco Guzm\'an, Nicholas Magazine, Jonas Mueller

entry.summary: VIALS is a visual QA benchmark of 161 interpretation tasks spanning real biotech workflow artifacts such as gel blots, microscopy, plasmid maps, and flow cytometry plots. Finds frontier vision-language models fail where practicing scientists succeed, exposing domain-specific visual reasoning deficits.

entry.title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy

author.name: Afonso Baldo, Hugo Pitorro, Areti Vassilopoulos, Anabela C. Areias, Maya D'Eon, Fab\'iola Costa, Ricardo Rei, Nuno M. Guerreiro

entry.summary: Builds an ontology of ten therapeutic moves grounded in MULTI-60, validated with five licensed psychologists, and uses it to compare frontier LLMs against human clinicians in psychotherapy sessions. Models over-use inquiry up to three times the human rate, neglect psychoeducation, and are strongly anchored to strategies initiated earlier in context; the paper also demonstrates move-level steering.

entry.title: CLEAR: Continuous Latent Adapter Routing for Utility-Preserving LLM Safety Alignment

author.name: Chengxiao Wang, Enyi Jiang, Xiaojing Liao, Sanmi Koyejo

entry.summary: CLEAR proposes conditional safety adaptation using a lightweight hidden-state gate to modulate activation strength of a low-rank safety adapter, reducing harmful completions while preserving benign-prompt utility of the frozen backbone. Shows improved HarmBench robustness with reduced degradation versus global safety tuning.

entry.title: Who Delegates to AI? Evidence from 53,000 Agent Configurations

author.name: Hyeongjae Lee, Jihyang Cheon, Lanu Kim

entry.summary: Proposes delegated exposure, a new measure capturing whether workers have actually committed tasks to AI, operationalized via the Agentic Adoption Index computed by embedding roughly 53,000 Manus marketplace agent skills and matching them to 18,000 O*NET task statements. Findings reveal where delegation concentrates versus where AI could theoretically perform tasks.

entry.title: Scaling Muon for Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Chenghao Li, Xiao Han, Xinxin Huang, Wei Liu, Boyang Li, Bing Xiao, Heran Zhang, Juanma Perez Rua, Ke Xu, Kangning Liu, Linjun Kuang, Na Li, Tan Wang, Tian Xie, Wei Peng, Yang Pei, Yifan Xu, Yuanhao Zhai, Yuwei Lin, Zhe Wang, Zihao He, Daniel Li, Junbiao Tang, Ziyang Jiang, Dake Chen

entry.summary: Establishes Muon optimizer scaling behavior on Diffusion Transformers from 1.3B to 15B parameters, confirming persistent advantages over AdamW. Introduces Periodic Row-wise Muon to amortize the expensive Newton-Schulz spectral update and reduce computation and communication overhead at scale, making Muon practical for large DiT training.

entry.title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses

author.name: Jiayi Li, Sanjana Menon, Brett Frischmann, Shomir Wilson, Sarah Rajtmajer

entry.summary: Empirically shows that affective context amplifies LLM sycophancy: user-facing responses systematically soften or withhold negative evaluations compared to independent judgments on identical content. Evaluated across seven models using Reddit datasets through an ingratiation-theory lens.

entry.title: Logic-VLA: A Temporal Logic Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Celina Shiyu Wang, Yiqi Zhao, Junjie Ye, Yue Wang, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh

entry.summary: Logic-VLA conditions a vision-language-action model on Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications provided at inference time, using a syntax-graph STL encoder pre-trained on temporal logic semantics, followed by STL-conditioned supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization over satisfying-versus-violating rollout pairs. This lets robots follow formally specified spatiotemporal and safety requirements rather than vague natural-language instructions.

entry.title: When Vocabulary Comprehension Fails Clinical Reasoning: Evaluating Therapy Bots' Safety Risks for Generation Alpha

author.name: Manisha Mehta, Virendra Mehta

entry.summary: Presents benchmarks evaluating therapy-bot safety for Generation Alpha, showing LLMs misread hyperbolic, ironic youth communication patterns in mental-health contexts following documented adolescent deaths linked to chatbot interactions. Includes 64 native-speaker-validated expressions with inter-rater reliability.

entry.title: Inhibitory Attention for Clinical Long-Context Reasoning: Characterizing and Mitigating Lost-in-the-Middle Effects in EHR Processing

author.name: Sanjay Basu

entry.summary: Systematically characterizes the lost-in-the-middle effect in electronic health records processing across six models and 2,196 instruction pairs, finding a 21.9 percentage-point accuracy gap between context positions and proposing inhibitory-attention mitigation strategies. Names the clinically consequential variant CLitM.

entry.title: Terminal Agents: A Survey of AI Agents in Command-Line Environments

author.name: Yi Bin, Xiaoyang Yuan, Haoxi Zeng, Wencheng Ye, Wenqi Shao, Chen Qian, Wei Ye, Yujuan Ding, Zheng Wang, Pengpeng Zeng, Jingkuan Song, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: A survey organizing terminal-mediated AI agents as systems whose action-observation loop runs through command execution and stateful textual environments, introducing a seven-dimensional terminal competence profile. It connects architecture, competence acquisition, and evaluation across previously siloed SE, tool-use, and computer-use literatures.

entry.title: Personalized Privacy Control in LLMs via Attention Head Intervention

author.name: Junseok Kim, Nakyeong Yang, Kyomin Jung

entry.summary: Introduces personalized privacy for LLMs, where disclosure boundaries vary by user within the same context, and releases P3Bench extending contextual privacy benchmarks with user-specific policies. Shows prompt-based controls fail reliably, motivating architectural interventions like attention head manipulation.

entry.title: CertVLA: Certified Defense against Physical Visual Attacks for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Hui Lu, Zhijie Peng, Yuqi Lin, Zaijia Yang, Jiaming He, Shuhan Ye, Yi Yu, Hanwei Zhu, Bingquan Shen, Alex Kot, Xudong Jiang

entry.summary: CertVLA provides certified defenses for closed-loop vision-language-action robot policies under bounded patch and texture attacks, calibrating regions of behaviorally consistent actions with deterministic covering masks ensuring at least one attack-free checked prediction.

entry.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy

author.name: Fatih Deniz, Yazan Boshmaf, Dorde Popovic, Issa Khalil

entry.summary: aiXamine is a unified black-box platform evaluating LLM safety, security, and privacy as interdependent properties via 46 automated red-teaming tests, exposing cross-dimensional trade-offs such as high safety-alignment scores alongside frequent benign refusals or capability gains paired with privacy losses.

entry.title: A Survey on Foundations and Frontiers of Multimodal Agentic Frameworks: Techniques and Applications

author.name: Neel Mokaria, Rishie Raj, Dheeraj Baiju, Xiaoqian Shen, Shraman Pramanick, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Arda Senocak, Mike Zheng Shou, Philip Torr, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Yapeng Tian, Ruohan Gao, Salman Khan, Sayan Nag, Sanjoy Chowdhury, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey analyzing how multimodality shapes agency across perception, reasoning, planning, memory, and action modules in LMM-based agentic frameworks. With a large, credible author team spanning KAUST, Oxford, Maryland, and others, it fills a gap left by text-only agent surveys.

entry.title: Testing and Evaluation of Agentic AI Systems In Military Command and Control

author.name: Ulysse Richard, Heather Frase, Sarah Cao, Di Cooke, Sebastian Kwon, Adrianna Tan

entry.summary: Structured review of 240 testing-and-evaluation practices for agentic AI in military command and control, deriving eight assumptions grouped into specifiability, stability, composability, and supervisability clusters that agentic properties systematically weaken, undermining assurance cases.

entry.title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning

author.name: Varun Giridhar, Anant Khandelwal, Jeremy A. Collins, Ignat Georgiev, Animesh Garg

entry.summary: Q-Planning equips large visuomotor behavior-cloning policies with a small off-policy Q-function trained on the same demonstrations, later absorbing failed deployment rollouts too, enabling self-improvement without the difficulty of RL fine-tuning billion-parameter policies.

entry.title: World models of environment, agent and joint agent-environment systems

author.name: Manuel Baltieri, Filippo Torresan, Yivan Zhang, Alexander Boyd, Fernando E. Rosas

entry.summary: Uses computational mechanics to define canonical predictive world models along three distinct channels: environment, agent, and the joint agent-environment process, formalized as epsilon-transducers and epsilon-machines. Environment-channel models recover standard predictive state representations while the others yield new analogous notions.

entry.title: Who Do Language Models Think Is Competent? A Mechanistic Analysis of Occupational Bias

author.name: Keren Fuentes, Aaron Mueller

entry.summary: Mechanistically analyzes occupational bias in language models, showing representational biases persist even when behavioral evaluations pass. Derives steering vectors for competence representations and verifies they causally mediate QA and hiring-task behavior in open-weight models.

entry.title: BackDFL: A Unified Benchmark For Backdoor Attacks and Defenses In Decentralized Federated Learning

author.name: Mouhamed Amine Bouchiha, Gregory Blanc, Yufei Han

entry.summary: BackDFL provides a unified benchmark for backdoor attacks and defenses in decentralized federated learning, arguing that reported robustness has been significantly overestimated due to simplified threat models, non-adaptive adversaries, and inconsistent protocols across studies.

entry.title: AsmEvo: Agentic Assembly-Level Optimization of AMD GPU Kernels with Functional Equivalence Verification

author.name: Ji Liu, Puyuan Yang, Rongzhang Zheng, Fan Wang, Jinglin Wang, Muhammad A. Awad, Mortis Huang, Andy Chang, Zekai Li, Zeping Li, Zihao An, Yue Liu, Yuchen Yang, Jianghui Wang, Chushi Chen, Ziqiong Liu, Fuwei Yang, Dong Li, Wen Heng Chung, Shengcai Liu, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: AsmEvo optimizes already-compiled AMDGPU code objects at assembly level with a long-horizon agentic loop: reconstructing reassemblable representations, proposing low-level edits, rebuilding ABI-preserving objects, and accepting candidates verified for functional equivalence against the binary oracle.

entry.title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs

author.name: Yunheng Li, Guohong Mu, Hao Li, Shengsheng Qian, Dingwen Zhang, Qibin Hou, Ming-Ming Cheng

entry.summary: OraRL improves sample efficiency of RL post-training for video MLLMs by repurposing ground-truth annotations as oracle rollouts inside on-policy groups, not merely as reward scorers. The paper carefully handles baseline-inversion issues that would otherwise turn positive targets harmful.

entry.title: MultiCube: Compositional 3D Generation With Part-Level Semantic and Spatial Control

author.name: Ava Pun, Kangle Deng, Yiheng Zhu, Jun-Yan Zhu, Maneesh Agrawala, Tinghui Zhou

entry.summary: MultiCube enables compositional 3D generation with independent part-level semantic and spatial control, taking a text prompt plus a part schema and bounding-box layout to output decomposed objects suited to professional game and animation workflows.

entry.title: Roadside-Cooperative Autonomous Driving: From Data Platform to Vision-Language End-to-End Reasoning

author.name: Yitao Xu, Tong Wu, Yiyan Wu, Guoji Xu, Yanbo Jiang, Jiahao Wang, Zehong Ke, Junkai Jiang, Fang Zhang, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: This work introduces V2XBench, a simulation platform with synchronized ego-roadside sensing and closed-loop evaluation, plus Chat-V2XBench, a progressively structured VQA dataset for cooperative driving reasoning. Building on these, the authors propose AURORA, an end-to-end cooperative driving framework with dual-view perception for vision-language roadside-assisted autonomy.

entry.title: Nexus: Depth-Adaptive KV-Cache Splicing and Retrieval-Decoupled Tool Routing for Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory

author.name: Mustafa Arslan

entry.summary: Introduces Nexus, which decouples MCP tool routing from quadratic schema prefill using an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer and compressed textual signatures instead of KV-cache splicing. Routing accuracy stays near 89 percent at 250 tools where concatenate-all baselines overflow the context window, with major TTFT gains.

entry.title: An LLM agent for end-to-end computational materials discovery

author.name: Chen Yuntong, Huang Ju, Liu Yu, Zhao Dan, Sun Mingqi, Ju Chentian, Liu Yanbing, Huang Lijiang, Zhao Guobin

entry.summary: MAESTRO is an LLM agent executing the full computational screening pipeline for metal-organic frameworks, from literature mining and structure linking to cost-stratified computation and identification of wet-flue-gas separation candidates drawn from unrelated studies.

entry.title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP

author.name: Shriti Priya, Teryl Taylor, Frederico Araujo

entry.summary: AEGIS prevents cross-domain resource abuse in the Model Context Protocol, where malicious agents exploit tool modalities such as oversized searches or videos to degrade service, providing consistent mitigations across text, image, video, and location vectors.

entry.title: Designing a Robust LLM-Based Evaluation System for Agentic AI in Drug Discovery Through Human Alignment

author.name: Emma Granqvist, Roc\'io Mercado, Samuel Genheden

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-as-a-Judge framework validated against human experts for evaluating the agentic drug-discovery assistant ChatInvent deployed at AstraZeneca, addressing the failure of reference-based metrics on open-ended tool-augmented outputs. Defines output-quality dimensions and measures judge-expert alignment.

entry.title: Rethinking Expressivity and Efficiency in Test-Time Training

author.name: Zeyun Zhong, Joya Chen, Manuel Martin, Frederik Diederichs, Juergen Gall, Juergen Beyerer

entry.summary: E2-TTT derives a closed-form chunk-level state transition that exactly reproduces per-token fast-weight and momentum dynamics in test-time training under standard approximations, enabling fully parallelized chunk training while preserving temporal update structure. Validated up to 1.3B parameters.

entry.title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

author.name: Zhibo Zhang, Zhen Ouyang, Ling Shi, Kailong Wang

entry.summary: Identifies a structural failure mode when applying representation engineering (steering via hidden-state edits) to Mixture-of-Experts models: behavioral perturbations corrupt router decisions. The proposed RARE framework projects perturbations onto the null space of the router matrix, preserving clean routing while steering behavior.

entry.title: Identify, Locate, Link: End-to-End Key-Value Extraction from Document Images

author.name: A. Said Gurbuz (IBM Research Zurich, ETH Zurich), Ahmed Nassar (IBM Research Zurich), Christoph Auer (IBM Research Zurich), Maksym Lysak (IBM Research Zurich), Lucas Morin (IBM Research Zurich), Matteo Omenetti (IBM Research Zurich), Tim Strohmeyer (IBM Research Zurich), Panagiotis Vagenas (IBM Research Zurich), Nikolaos Livathinos (IBM Research Zurich), Michele Dolfi (IBM Research Zurich), Peter Staar (IBM Research Zurich)

entry.summary: IBM Research Zurich fine-tunes the compact 256M-parameter SmolDocling VLM to perform end-to-end key-value extraction from document images in a single pass, jointly solving identification, localization, and linking without OCR preprocessing. Extends DocTags with key/value/region/link tags and adds a synthetic augmentation pipeline to overcome data scarcity.

entry.title: Breaking High Confidence: Practical Face Impersonation under High-Security Thresholds

author.name: Changjin Kim, Seunghun Paik, Dongsoo Kim, Jae Hong Seo

entry.summary: First successful impersonation attack on face recognition systems operating under high-security threshold settings, focusing on practical score-based impersonation scenarios relevant to banking and airport deployments.

entry.title: EndoLIFT: Language-Disambiguated Latent-Conditioned Rectified Flow for Bidirectional Endoscopic Control

author.name: Chi Kit Ng, Yidong Zhang, Lui Siu Hing, Jinsong Lin, Tianchun Wu, Ho Yin Chim, Zhiqing Tang, Tao Yang, Huxin Gao, Trevor Yeung, Raymond Shing-Yan Tang, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: EndoLIFT formalizes intent aliasing in bidirectional endoscopic control, where nearly identical visual scenes require opposite actions depending on procedure phase, and proposes a vision-language-action policy combining explicit language-based intent conditioning with a latent-conditioned rectified-flow action expert. This enables safe advancement and withdrawal behavior during gastrointestinal endoscopy.

entry.title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: A Systematic Analysis of Prompt Lexical Sensitivity and Its Impacts on Quality

author.name: Qipeng Xie, Zi Liang, Jiafei Wu, Yufei Chen, Weizheng Wang, Wenao Ma, Zhong Ming, Haiqin Yang, Kaishun Wu

entry.summary: Performs the first large-scale n-gram token-level analysis of prompt stability using 132,000 prompt variants, revealing a scaling-law-like relation between higher task performance and lower variance under lexical perturbation. Identifies domain terminology and other linguistic drivers of robustness.

entry.title: Large Scale AI Grading of Handwritten Physics Assessments: Score Agreement and Olympiad Team Selection Outcomes

author.name: Praveen Pathak, Siddharth Tiwary, Charudatt Kadolkar, Vijay Singh, David Rakestraw, Shirish Pathare, Anwesh Mazumdar

entry.summary: Evaluated GPT-5.5-based grading of 10,364 scanned handwritten pages from physics Olympiad and university exams against official rubrics, with blind double grading showing sufficient agreement to inform high-stakes outcomes like Olympiad team selection.

entry.title: Beyond End-to-End Success: Diagnosing Failures in Long-Horizon Security LLM Agents

author.name: Wei Shao, Chongzhou Fang, Zuxiong Tan, Zequan Liang, Setareh Rafatirad, Avesta Sasan, Houman Homayoun

entry.summary: Diagnostic methodology for long-horizon security agents instrumenting tasks with checkpoints to separate failures before and after capability exposure, then applying controlled interventions across delayed-information reuse, state reuse, strategy recovery, and decision-making task families.

entry.title: Vis-Poison: Poisoning Visual Knowledge in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Rujin Liang, Zhongpu Chen, Yuhao Lei, Xin Miao

entry.summary: Vis-Poison introduces visual knowledge poisoning of multimodal RAG where the poisoned image itself carries the payload without touching captions or metadata, constructed via automated multi-agent image generation and shown effective across representative multimodal RAG pipelines.

entry.title: Multilingual Verifier Bias in RLVR: Benchmark, Rollout Diagnosis, and the Cross-Lingual Selection Bottleneck

author.name: Chenyu Zhou, Qiliang Jiang, Xu Zhou

entry.summary: Shows exact-match verifiers used in RLVR turn format and script variation into language-dependent false-negative reward noise in multilingual settings, and introduces an auditing protocol with verifier-robustness suites and language-conditioned reward-error metrics across Japanese, English, and Chinese rollouts.

entry.title: Grounded-Exo2Ego: Structured Semantic Grounding for Robust Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation

author.name: Shengze Wang, Michael Stengel, Tianye Li, Seonwook Park, Amrita Mazumdar, Koki Nagano, Alex Trevithick, Shalini De Mello

entry.summary: Grounded-Exo2Ego generates egocentric video from a single exocentric video via a dual-branch diffusion model coupling geometric anchoring from 3D reconstruction with a semantic grounding branch, addressing unreliable geometry under extreme viewpoint changes. Targets AR/VR and physical-AI applications.

entry.title: VT-MUSE: Multimodal Unified Sequential Visuotactile Representation Learning for Manipulation

author.name: Congsheng Xu, Qiaochu Yang, Fangyuan Shi, Yifan Han, Baijun Chen, Yiming Wang, Haonan Zhao, Daolin Ma, Xiaokang Yang, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: VT-MUSE introduces a two-stage multimodal representation learning framework for visuotactile manipulation that jointly adapts modality-specific encoders via cross-modal temporal alignment and masked-view consistency, then uses a conditional variational latent model over masked visual sequences and full tactile histories. It addresses the common limitation of encoding vision and touch independently and ignoring temporal contact evolution.

entry.title: Truth Lies Deep: Countering Semantic Camouflage via Latent Intent Verification

author.name: Md. Hasib Ur Rahman

entry.summary: Demonstrates that semantic camouflage attacks wrap harmful intent in benign narrative contexts to bypass LLM refusal guardrails, and analyzes latent activation trajectories across Phi-3, Qwen2.5, and Gemma-2b families. It identifies a universal Intent Horizon, a critical depth where harmful intent becomes decodable regardless of surface framing.

entry.title: Consilience: Conformally Calibrated Communication Control for Hidden-Profile Multi-Agent Reasoning

author.name: Abhijith Babu, Ramneet Kaur, Vishal Pramanik, Olivera Kotevska, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Susmit Jha, Sunny Raj, Yanzhao Wu, Sumit Kumar Jha, Anirban Roy

entry.summary: Consilience steers and certifies multi-agent LLM communication in hidden-profile settings using a compact discussion state capturing uncertainty, disagreement, evidence gain, redundancy, and premature consensus. It provides inference-time guarantees that conversational actions are appropriate, beyond fixed schedules and unstructured debate.

entry.title: Evaluating Skills, Not Just Agents: Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills

author.name: Christopher Kevin, Narendran Raghavan, Jean-Francois Puget, Roshni Malani, Meghana Puvvadi, Moshe Abramovitch, Mohit Gupta, Rama Akkiraju, Subodh Prabhu, Yogesh Dangi, Wei Luo, Seong Hee Lee

entry.summary: ACES evaluates reusable enterprise agent skills via paired live trials with and without the target skill, normalizing trajectories into a standard interchange format and grading six dimensions under identical model, sandbox, and policy conditions. It shifts enterprise gates from static artifact scanning to evidence-based deployment questions.

entry.title: AgentMercury: Your Agent Can Synthesize Verifiable Environments for Business Scenarios at scale

author.name: Minbyul Jeong, Chanwoong Yoon

entry.summary: AgentMercury synthesizes executable environments from high-level business scenarios by instantiating persistent worlds with entities, services, tools, state, and cross-service invariants, from which diverse tasks and trajectories emerge, decoupling environment construction from predefined tasks.

entry.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Chunyi Wang, Yunfei Ke, Junfeng Yang, Yun-Yun Tsai, Penghui Li

entry.summary: ARQ automatically refines CodeQL queries for C/C++ vulnerability detection using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized programs, exploiting disagreements between program execution and query verdicts to expose false positives and negatives.

entry.title: CARD: Diagnosing Belief to Action Routing Failures in Vision Language Models

author.name: Souptik Kumar Majumdar, Fabian K\"ogel, Andreas Bulling

entry.summary: CARD steers VLM activations along one axis while measuring another axis's predictions on Relay Chain, a new cooperative grid-world benchmark, diagnosing that models fail to incorporate belief representations into action prediction despite internally representing partner beliefs.

entry.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs

author.name: Luka Ribar, Jeevan Bhoot, Douglas Orr

entry.summary: Llama-Mobile compresses vision-language models to mobile devices via a self-generated-data quantization pipeline requiring no access to original training setup, plus a novel 2.7-bit-per-parameter Arm-CPU-executable format, shrinking Llama 3.2 11B Vision to 3.7 GB with 8-bit activations and strong VQA performance.

entry.title: Self-Speculation for Faster Reasoning Models

author.name: Ravisri Valluri, Tung Nguyen, Aditya Grover

entry.summary: SSR is a training-free self-speculative decoding method for reasoning models that uses the partial chain-of-thought answer distribution as its own draft, exploiting reasoning-workflow structure rather than token-level tricks to cut latency in interactive settings.

entry.title: Memory Augmentation Unlocks Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

author.name: Simeng Zhang, Yilong Chen, Wenyuan Zhang, Zhenyu Zhang, Yao Chen, Junyuan Shang, Tingwen Liu

entry.summary: Formalizes a Context-Generation Substitution Law trading off explicit reasoning context versus decode-time chain-of-thought generation, then proposes Memory-Augmented Compression: a training-free method that builds reusable reasoning memories from historical traces and injects them as prefill-side scaffolds to shorten CoT without losing coherence.

entry.title: DiffVC-ONE: Diffusion-based Generative Video Compression with One-Step Video Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Wenzhuo Ma, Zhenzhong Chen

entry.summary: DiffVC-ONE builds generative video compression around a one-step video diffusion transformer, using a unified unidirectional latent compressor and a single-step spatio-temporal enhancement pass over groups of pictures to achieve temporal consistency at low bitrate with low inference cost.

entry.title: LoRC: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Low-Rank Collapse in Semantic Residuals

author.name: Haozhen Yan, Ruoxin Chen, Jiahui Zhan, Bo Wang, Youchang Xiao, Shouhong Ding, Liqing Zhang, Taiping Yao, Jianfu Zhang

entry.summary: LoRC identifies an architecture-agnostic forensic signature of modern generators: low-rank collapse in the semantic-residual orthogonal subspace during final decoding. It decouples this signal for AI-generated image detection that generalizes across generator architectures.

entry.title: PhysCaP: Grounding Code-as-Policy Agent with Physics-Informed Exploration

author.name: Chen-Yu Lin, Jing-Wen Chen, Hsueh-En Chang, Hung-An Chen, Sheng-Hsun Chang, Chi-Pin Huang, Fu-En Yang, Min-Hung Chen, Yi-Ting Chen, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Shao-Hua Sun

entry.summary: PhysCaP augments code-as-policy frameworks for robotic manipulation with a physics-informed exploration layer enabling active perception: training-free modules estimate object mass and stiffness from proprioception alone, while a dual-agent Planner/Explorer design balances exploration costs against information gain. It targets latent physical properties that passive VLA policies cannot infer.

entry.title: How to Train a Real-World Silicon Concierge? Internalizing Complex Business Workflow to Only OneModel

author.name: Chang Liu, Chaoyang Ning, Dayi Jiang, Enrui Gu, Fang Ran, Hongyan Xue, Huaqing Li, Hui Cai, Jia Liu, Jiang-Ming Yang, Jianshe Li, Jiawei Luo, Jin Zhou, Leshen Zhu, Lihui Chen, Liying Ma, Lyuxin Xue, Mengjian Ji, Ruijia Xu, Wei Ren, Wei Wu, Xiaoling Qu, Xiaoyun Feng, Xin Zhang, Xixie Zhou, Xuanwei Hu, Yan Chen, Yichao Wang, Yongqi Tong, Yu Liu, Yuhong Zhou, Zemin Sun, Zhenwen Xu, Zhiling Liu, Zifan Wang

entry.summary: OneModel consolidates complex business logic and SOPs directly into model parameters via continual pre-training and logic-compilation SFT, replacing modular router-retriever-planner pipelines in a deployed global financial service system. Reports reduced cascading errors and latency.

entry.title: AffordAny: Open-World 3D Affordance Grounding from Monocular RGB Images via Vision-Language-Guided Geometric Reasoning

author.name: Junqi Wu, Kaihua Tang, Xuanwen Chen, Hongzhi Li, Jianqiang Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua

entry.summary: AffordAny grounds open-world 3D affordances from monocular RGB images using a frozen VLM-guided decoder, automated text-conditioned part-supervision generation, and pseudo-label self-training, delivering a benchmark of 10,633 part samples across 473 categories.

entry.title: NeSAM: Neuro-Symbolic Kinodynamics with Soil Adaptation for Off-Road Mobility

author.name: Chenhui Pan, Tong Xu, Francesco Cancelliere, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: NeSAM is a neuro-symbolic framework for off-road vehicle mobility combining differentiable Bekker-Wong terramechanics with learned terrain representations and a Transformer-based residual dynamics model for long-horizon six-DOF kinodynamic prediction. Explicit soil mechanics improve interpretability over pure learned kinodynamic models while residuals correct model-data discrepancies.

entry.title: SAGE: A Unified Algebra and Self-Adaptive Execution for AI Functions in SQL

author.name: Xiangqi Wang, Nhan H. Pham, Oktie Hassanzadeh, Dharmashankar Subramanian, Xiangliang Zhang

entry.summary: SAGE provides a unified logical and physical framework for AI functions in SQL using three typed primitives covering row transformation, aggregation, and pairwise relationship generation, composed with relational operators under a confidence-gated execution interface. It includes analytical optimizations for the difficult AI_JOIN case.

entry.title: Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks: Encoding Anatomic Priors in Loss and Architecture, with an SE(3) Formulation of Guidewire-Induced Aortoiliac Deformation

author.name: David P. Stonko

entry.summary: Introduces Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks encoding soft anatomic priors as loss penalties and hard priors into architecture, by analogy with physics-informed networks. Demonstrated on predicting guidewire-induced aortoiliac deformation from limited clinical data.

entry.title: BF1: A Causal Dyadic Sparse-Attention Retrofit for Efficient Long-Context Transformers

author.name: Hina Dixit

entry.summary: BF1 retrofits pretrained transformers with a deterministic dyadic sparse-attention route combining local neighborhood, global first block, and logarithmically spaced history blocks, achieving O(n log n) interactions per layer with correctness-gated conversion and matched topology controls on Blackwell GPUs.

entry.title: Peer-Voted LLM-Agent Stress Tests Find Feed-Induced Lexical Convergence but No Reliable Matched-Exposure Advantage for Distributed Sources

author.name: Rana Muhammad Usman, Dominic Williamson

entry.summary: PV-SST is a peer-voted social-platform stress-test testbed with a frozen, preregistered matched-exposure experiment across four topics, seeds, and open-weight model families, finding peer-feed exposure induces measurable lexical convergence but no reliable advantage for distributed content sources.

entry.title: Do SpeechLMs Hear Their Own Opinions? Diagnosing and Mitigating Previous-Belief Contamination in Streaming Emotion Understanding

author.name: Haoyue Liu, Zhichao Wang, Ye Chen, Haonan Deng, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Shows previous-belief contamination in streaming emotion understanding: changing only the injected prior label collapses same-audio accuracy from 72.5 percent to 30.4 percent with strongly asymmetric label pull, and proposes EmoUpdate, a training-free separation of perception from historical-state revision.

entry.title: RODE: A Radial-Orthogonal Decoupled Engine for Optimization

author.name: Guoxiang Xu, Bince Qu, Qi Sun, Cheng Zhuo

entry.summary: Introduces RODE, an optimizer that decouples the radial (norm) and directional components of matrix-aware updates, giving each its own rule and step size, with Newton-Schulz conditioning in the tangent space. Controlled GPT-2 experiments show gains from direct norm control plus the directional channel.

entry.title: Truthful Calibration Measures for Sequential Prediction

author.name: Anagha Gokul, Jason Hartline, Lunjia Hu, Jonathan Ullman, Yifan Wu

entry.summary: Resolves an open question in sequential binary prediction by proving exact truthfulness of calibration measures is incompatible with completeness and soundness, then constructing additively and multiplicatively approximately truthful measures via two general reductions from base measures.

entry.title: RISE: Adaptive Imagination for World Action Models

author.name: Hongbo Lu, Liang Yao, Chenghao He, Hao Han, Fan Liu, Wenlong Liao, Tao He, Pai Peng

entry.summary: RISE makes imagination adaptive in World Action Models for planning: a latent evaluator estimates expected planning benefit of continued rollout while a rollout gate trades benefit against compute, deciding Roll or Stop per step. Includes handling of the single-realized-future limitation of driving logs.

entry.title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter

author.name: Yunze Tong, Mushui Liu, Canyu Zhao, Shiyi Zhang, Didi Zhu, Peng Zhang, Wanggui He, Jinlong Liu, Ying Chen, Hao Jiang, Pipei Huang, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: InfinityEdit defines infinite video editing: applying edit requests continuously to unbounded incoming streams such as live games, using a lightweight edit-ignition adapter rather than in-place frame-aligned editing assumptions.

entry.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs

author.name: Xianyun Sun, Chaoyou Fu, Zhengye Zhang, Feiyang Duan, Qingyuan Cao, Yonghui Niu, Sihang Yuan, Ge Zhang, Caifeng Shan

entry.summary: OmniAssistBench benchmarks Omni-LLMs as proactive real-time video assistants, handling diverging interaction paths via predefined priors since static offline datasets cannot capture how model responses reshape user actions toward goals.

entry.title: ViTacPhys: Physical Property-Aware Grasping from Human Visual-Tactile Demonstrations

author.name: Yiwen Liu, Yujun Zhu, Kui Jia, Zhao Liao, Yangwei You, Shuaijun Wang

entry.summary: ViTacPhys estimates object mass, friction-coefficient classes, and continuous stiffness from human visual-tactile manipulation demonstrations, trained on 60 rigid and deformable objects using temporal visual-tactile modeling, cross-attention fusion, and a VLM-derived semantic prior. Reported accuracy reaches 97.2 percent for mass classification and 98.8 percent for friction classes.

entry.title: When Retrieval Fails Before It Begins: Structurally Indirect Prerequisite Eviction as a Retention Failure in Agentic Memory

author.name: Minkyu Song

entry.summary: Identifies structurally indirect prerequisite eviction as a pre-retrieval failure mode in budgeted agentic memory, where weakly query-aligned upstream blocks get discarded before they are needed. Its Dependency-aware Semantic Garbage Collection rule lifts full-chain retention from 0.03 to 0.90 under lexical encoding and to 1.00 under sentence encoders.

entry.title: Poly-InstructTTS: Learning In-the-Wild Expressive Speech Synthesis from Open-Ended Instructions

author.name: Junhui Zhang, Qianhui Xu, Qingxiang Guo, Dawei Yang, Ling Miao, Qiangqiang Wang, Yang Song

entry.summary: Poly-InstructTTS learns expressive speech synthesis from open-ended instructions using a 1,000-hour instruction-annotated audiovisual corpus covering 1,000+ emotions and styles, combining attribute-thinking tokens with flow matching and speaker fine-tuning for persona-preserving control.

entry.title: Evaluation-as-Search: Adaptive Discovery of Grounding Failures in Meeting Assistants

author.name: Sami Khairy, Yasaman Hosseinkashi, Vishak Gopal, Ross Cutler

entry.summary: Evaluation-as-Search frames quality evaluation of meeting assistants as adaptive search over natural participant questions, concentrating probing on failure-prone cognitive demands via UCB-scored coverage maps, yielding the 3,000-item MeetingProbe benchmark of grounding failures.

entry.title: LingShu: A Large-Scale Symptom-Centric Contextualized Knowledge Graph Bridging Traditional Chinese Medicine and Modern Biomedicine

author.name: Rui Hua, Zixin Shu, Kai Chang, Dengying Yan, Jianan Xia, Hui Zhu, Shujie Song, Shurui Yang, Tongxin Wang, Yue Yin, Yu Wei, Lijuan Pei, Yunhui Hu, Hao Xu, Mingzhong Xiao, Xiaodong Li, Haibin Yu, Runshun Zhang, Wenjia Wang, Baoyan Liu, Xuezhong Zhou

entry.summary: LingShu is a symptom-centric contextualized knowledge graph with 17.33 million entity records bridging Traditional Chinese Medicine and modern biomedicine through symptoms as a shared phenotypic layer supporting conditional biomedical knowledge representation.

entry.title: Harmonic Torsional Diffusion for Protein-Ligand Flexible Docking

author.name: Maksim Zhdanov, Pavel Strashnov, Vladislav Kurenkov

entry.summary: Harmony performs flexible protein-ligand docking with harmonic torsional diffusion, parameterizing ligand and side-chain torsional score fields as derivatives of learned harmonic potentials on the circle/torus with analytically supplied noise dependence via the heat semigroup.

entry.title: ArtiMo: Agent-Driven Articulated Mesh Animation

author.name: Chunyu Zou, Peng Dai, Yi-Hua Huang, Ze Yuan, Jingwei Huang, Yeming Yao, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: ArtiMo is a zero-shot agent-driven framework animating articulated meshes from text, orchestrating LLM/VLM reasoning and planning with URDF kinematic constraints to satisfy causality and instruction fidelity absent task-specific training data.

entry.title: MotionPhys: Detecting AI-Generated Videos via Physical Consistency of Optical-Flow Trajectories

author.name: Haojin He, Hao Tan, Zichang Tan, Ajian Liu, Jun Wan

entry.summary: MotionPhys detects AI-generated videos via statistical discrepancies in optical-flow trajectory physics, exploiting that generated videos look plausible frame-to-frame but violate inertia, force continuity, and trajectory geometry over complete actions.

entry.title: Just Noticeable Difference Modeling for Token Compression in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zhuoyuan Li, Rui Zhao, Jin Wang, Hanwei Zhu, Cong Zhang, Giuseppe Valenzise, Weisi Lin, Kin-Man Lam

entry.summary: Applies just-noticeable-difference modeling to token compression in vision-language-action models, compressing based on how much a token can change before causing unacceptable downstream action deviation, a receiver-dependent tolerance suited to latency-closed-loop robot control.

entry.title: TaPeR: Probabilistic Recovery of Sparse Task Precedence Graphs from a Handful of Demonstrations

author.name: Adrian R\"ofer, Karla Stepanova, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: TaPeR probabilistically recovers sparse task precedence graphs from only a handful of demonstrations, using simple kinematic graphs and distributions over relative object poses instead of requiring explicitly grounded symbolic predicates. This allows robots to flexibly reorder partially ordered subtasks in long-horizon assembly while preserving validity.

entry.title: Lost in Translation: How Universal Ethical Values Fail to Translate Across Global Contexts

author.name: Ozioma C. Oguine, Munachimso B. Oguine, Cesar Cervera, Jenny Yang, Pooja Voladoddi, Mario Rodriguez, Saif Eddin Bani Malhem, Karla Badillo-Urquiola, Daricia Wilkinson

entry.summary: Qualitative study of 14 experts across 10 countries showing that universal AI ethics values get locally reinterpreted: privacy becomes collective and relational, transparency becomes trust-building accountability, amid structural inequality and extractive practices. It challenges uniform operationalization of fairness and accountability frameworks.

entry.title: AUSO: Action-Level Unified Skill Optimization from Internalization to Utilization

author.name: Huizu Lin, Chengkai Huang, Tianqi Gao, Tao Huang, Daijiao Liu, Tongxin Li, Xiaoyan Sun, Lina Yao

entry.summary: AUSO unifies skill internalization and utilization for agents through a progressive, action-level optimization scheme recognizing that skills should first teach, then form capabilities, then be invoked selectively. Avoids uniform credit assignment across trajectory actions.

entry.title: Clarify-Then-Search: A Clarification Benchmark for Deep Search with End-to-End Nugget Restoration

author.name: Deqiang Huang, Jingbo Zhou, Xinjiang Lu, Tong Xu, Hua Wu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Clarify-Then-Search is a 518-instance benchmark built on real Baidu queries measuring whether LLM-generated clarification questions improve downstream deep-search utility, using evidence-grounded weighted nuggets with traceable sources as golden references.

entry.title: Making Deployments Safe at Meta: Health Checks for Continuous Change-Safety

author.name: Prakash KL, Anton Korenkov, Uttam Thakore, Christopher Hegre

entry.summary: Describes Meta's Service Health Checker deployment-time infrastructure mediating release velocity versus reliability across thousands of services, composing templated metric queries, thresholds, and workflow predicates integrated with tiered rollouts and automatic rollback.

entry.title: Capturing Cardiac Cyclicity through Phase-Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Blaise Delaney, Dominic Dootson, Juan Jose Juan Castella, Salil Patel, Andrew Pfaff, Yuji Xing, Jonny Hancox, Karin Sevegnani

entry.summary: Derives a phase-equivariant self-supervised objective exploiting the cardiac cycle's periodicity, introducing Winder, a joint-embedding model with fixed, closed-form transport derived from cycle geometry. Matches state-of-the-art diagnostic accuracy on PTB-XL with roughly a 1M parameter footprint under frozen linear probes.

entry.title: Rethinking Demonstration Unlearning in Imitation Learning for Robotics

author.name: Jiazhuo Li, Yu Zhang, Yiming Fei, Kangkang Dong, Xiaojun Zhu, Houde Liu, Jinze Tao

entry.summary: Proposes a retrain-calibrated audit for demonstration unlearning in imitation-learned robot policies, measuring both behavior divergence from a retrained policy and detectability of removed demonstrations, since metrics like forgetting loss do not capture closed-loop effects.

entry.title: Aggregating Visual Information with Optimal Transport for VideoLM Token Compression

author.name: Wenti Yin, Xiaotian Han, Junyuan Shang, Yuchen Ding, Shuohuan Wang, Dianhai Yu, Changxin Gao, Nong Sang

entry.summary: AVIOT casts video token compression for video-language models as an optimal transport problem, moving a dense measure of frame observations onto a compact target support whose coupling directly specifies compressed representations while preserving information dispersed across frames.

entry.title: Generating Multi-view Adversarial Examples for Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer

author.name: Qi Song, Ziyuan Luo, Haoliang Han, Renjie Wan

entry.summary: MVAP-G generates imperceptible adversarial perturbations consistent across multiple views in a single feed-forward pass, exposing vulnerabilities of VGGT-style feed-forward 3D reconstruction models where prior universal perturbations fail.

entry.title: Latent Ordinal Evidence, Misaligned Outputs: Inference-Time Ordinal Lens Alignment for Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Haiming Li, Yingsheng Liu, Jingmin Zhu, Siyuan Yan, Xieji Li, Jiajun Sun, Zhen Yu, Zongyuan Ge

entry.summary: Shows multimodal LLMs encode ordinal evidence linearly in hidden states (Spearman up to 0.938) yet digit-token outputs barely expose it, with the unembedding filtering the ordinal direction; proposes inference-time ordinal lens alignment to recover ordered regression performance.

entry.title: Anchoring Instruction Outside Mask: Exact Reference Caching for Efficient In-Context Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Yangshuai Liu, Zheming Li, Jiaao Li, Kang He, Ziliang Lai, Zhitai Liu, Chengru Song

entry.summary: Enables exact reference caching for in-context diffusion transformers by anchoring instructions outside masks, allowing reference K and V to be computed once and reused across denoising steps without blocking text-reference attention interactions.

entry.title: Difficulty-Calibrated Interpolation Paths for Conditional Flow Matching

author.name: Airin Akter Tania, Md Raihan Khan

entry.summary: Difficulty-Calibrated Flow Matching derives interpolation schedules from the model itself: a pilot run records per-time loss and sets the schedule to its quantile function, lingering where velocity is hardest to learn rather than fixing the path a priori.

entry.title: Basin-Preserving Discretizations of Modern Hopfield Retrieval Dynamics: Energy Cells, Dissipation, and the Attention Limit

author.name: Francisco R. Villatoro

entry.summary: This theoretical paper studies which time discretizations of modern Hopfield network retrieval dynamics preserve energy decay, equilibria, and crucially basins of attraction, connecting Hopfield retrieval to attention updates as difference-of-convex minimization. The authors introduce energy cells and prove that relaxed attention maps and implicit Euler preserve basin structure under stated conditions.

entry.title: Dual-Cache Latent Space Communication between Heterogeneous Language Models

author.name: Jiyao Liu, Qi Zhang, Yaoyi Jia, Ziwen Kan, Song Wang

entry.summary: Extends KV-cache-based latent communication between heterogeneous LLM agents with a dual-cache scheme relaxing three restrictions of prior protocols like C2C and LCF-X, including sharer-side-only compression and shared layer alignment. This avoids autoregressive decoding on the communication critical path.

entry.title: Six misconceptions about large language models: A minimal model and diagnostic taxonomy

author.name: Zhicheng Lin

entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of five open-source LLMs against classical ML and frontier proprietary baselines for malaria virtual screening on Malaria-Instruct with rigorous out-of-distribution splits, showing domain-specific fine-tuning is indispensable with TxGemma-9B reaching ROC-AUC 0.731.

entry.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib

author.name: Shane Caldwell

entry.summary: ProofJudge is an agentic LLM-as-judge scoring Lean 4 Mathlib proofs along five quality dimensions beyond kernel-verified correctness, grounded by tool access to library state, validated against 218 real PRs by checking whether judges prefer accepted versions over revised-away ones.

entry.title: Consistency Models for Fast MRI Reconstruction Using Regularization by Denoising

author.name: Merve G\"ulle, Junno Yun, Ya\c{s}ar Utku Al\c{c}alar, Mehmet Ak\c{c}akaya

entry.summary: CM-RED embeds a pretrained consistency model into regularization-by-denoising MRI reconstruction on accelerated proximal gradients with controlled noise injection, achieving fast single-pass generative reconstruction competitive with iterative diffusion priors on fastMRI.

entry.title: Causal Modeling of Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes via Adaptive LLM Proposals

author.name: Kavimayil P. Komarasamy, Saurabh Mathur, Ameet Soni, David M. Haas, Kristian Kersting, Sriraam Natarajan

entry.summary: A neurosymbolic causal-discovery framework for adverse pregnancy outcomes that treats an LLM as an adaptive proposal distribution, iteratively generating hypotheses scored against scarce clinical data. Combines broad LLM prior knowledge with empirical constraints where pure data-driven or pure LLM approaches fail.

entry.title: Asymmetric Capacity Allocation in Self-Refinement Pipelines

author.name: Zhuoyi Yang, Ian G. Harris, Salar Hashemitaheri, Cassie Huang, Yuangang Li, Hyunwoo Oh, Paul Dourish, Tony Givargis, Mohsen Imani, Li Zhang

entry.summary: First stage-wise study of model-size allocation in generate-critique-revise self-refinement pipelines, using 6 sizes of Qwen3 and other families across 5 benchmarks, showing equal-capacity stages waste resources and smaller models suffice for some stages.

entry.title: An ambiguity taxonomy for evaluating large language model performance on clinical registry abstraction: a multi-site prospective study

author.name: James Matheson, Betsy Castillo, Andrew Y. Shin, David Scheinker

entry.summary: Multi-site prospective evaluation of LLM performance on unprocessed EMR data for ACC NCDR cardiovascular registry abstraction, with question-specific document sets, blinded ground truth by two abstractors, and an ambiguity taxonomy for registry questions.

entry.title: A Factorial Ablation of a Speech-to-SFT Pipeline: Differential Effects on Data Quality and Downstream Transfer

author.name: Wonsup Shin, Jingu Kim

entry.summary: Presents the first public stage-by-stage ablation of a production speech-to-SFT pipeline using a 2x2 factorial design toggling transcript refinement and data-quality refinement. Fine-tunes nine models across five families on Korean medical and finance recordings with four LLM judges, blind expert evaluation, and downstream MCQA benchmarks.

entry.title: M2Depth: Unifying Monocular Depth Foundation Priors with Multi-View Stereo

author.name: Byeonggwon Lee, Sanggi Lee, Siwoo Lee, Khang Truong Giang, Soohwan Song

entry.summary: M2Depth couples monocular depth foundation priors with cascade multi-view stereo through bidirectional mutual refinement, letting MVS resolve scale ambiguity in monocular predictions while monocular context fills occluded and low-overlap regions.

entry.title: Masking Is Not Enough: Generative Restoration for Multimodal De-Identification in Medical AI

author.name: Shiva Shrestha, Zongxing Xie, Chen Zhao, Liran Ma, Zhipeng Cai, Honghui Xu

entry.summary: ClinX provides end-to-end multimodal PHI sanitization for medical image-text pairs, detecting visible identifiers via OCR, constructing masks, and applying generative restoration rather than masking alone, evaluated alongside downstream reasoning utility.

entry.title: Sparse Light Field Sampling Improves Casual 3D and 4D Reconstruction

author.name: Shamus Li, Ruiming Cao, Laura Waller, Kristina Monakhova, Sara Fridovich-Keil

entry.summary: Analyzes sensor-limited and exposure-limited multi-view capture from commodity devices (smartphones, stereo, light field cameras), introducing a new dataset and showing sparse light-field sampling improves casual 3DGS and 4DGS reconstruction versus monocular streams.

entry.title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Michelle Lin

entry.summary: StateSight is a procedurally generated benchmark isolating latent spatial-state reconstruction in vision-language models through cube-net opposite-face reasoning, occluded cube-tower counting, and connected-component counting with deterministic oracle labels. GPT-5.5, an established production model released months earlier, scores only 59.3, 33.3, and 28.3 percent across the tasks.

entry.title: Root cause analysis via difference graph discovery from linear time-series data

author.name: Anouk Ruer, Timoth\'ee Loranchet, Daria Bystrova, Charles K. Assaad

entry.summary: Formalizes root cause analysis for anomalies in linear time-series as difference graph discovery between normal and anomalous regimes, targeting variables whose causal coefficients change. Adapts population-level difference graph methods to dynamic structural causal models and validates on simulated data plus a practical case study.

entry.title: When Do LLMs Replace Fine-Tuned NLU? A Decision Framework for Intent Detection in Production Conversational Systems

author.name: Carson Rodrigues, Oysturn Vas

entry.summary: Head-to-head comparison of zero-shot LLMs (Claude Haiku) against fine-tuned RoBERTa and simpler baselines for intent detection on ATIS and CLINC150 with proper confidence intervals, concluding the answer depends on intent-space breadth: fine-tuning wins narrowly with huge cost advantages, while ties occur on broad schemas.

entry.title: VA-DPO: Valence-Arousal Direct Preference Optimization for Controllable Emotion Generation in Language Models

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim

entry.summary: VA-DPO specifies desired emotion as a continuous point in valence-arousal space and adapts Direct Preference Optimization with a frozen regressor scoring candidate pairs by distance to target, training a LoRA adapter to hit fine-grained affective states beyond discrete labels.

entry.title: Towards Traffic Modelling of Multi-Agent Systems: The Role of Coordination Topology

author.name: Davide Lamagna, Albert Cabellos, Alberto Rodriguez-Natal, G\'abor R\'etv\'ari, Berta Serracanta

entry.summary: Empirical characterization of LLM-call interarrival distributions across sequential, star, and full-mesh agentic coordination topologies over 500 runs each, showing coordination logic rather than user arrival governs traffic and classical network traffic models may not transfer.

entry.title: JuryProbe: An Empirical Consensus-Risk Diagnostic for Routing Reference-Free Factuality Judge Panels to Grounded Verification

author.name: Tianxin Zhou, Ruixi Lin

entry.summary: JuryProbe estimates consensus risk in reference-free LLM factuality judge panels using false-negative-only correlation and false-consensus lift on a calibration probe, routing flagged majority accepts to reference-grounded verification on audited FEVER corruptions.

entry.title: SPARCL: Spectral Partitioned Analytic Continual Learning

author.name: James Hartley, Zeropy Surio, Daniel Whitmore, Hannah Clarke, Thomas Reed

entry.summary: SPARCL identifies spectral interference as the true cause of drift in analytic continual learning: shared inverse autocorrelation operators let new-task samples perturb old-class logits even without revisiting labels. It partitions spectra to mitigate this forgetting mechanism.

entry.title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields

author.name: Baixin Li, Haiyun He

entry.summary: SAC-Copula watermarks diffusion language models using smooth, locally correlated Gumbel perturbation fields built from a Gaussian copula, matching iterative parallel unmasking dynamics better than i.i.d. perturbations, with a covariance-aware detector and native-sample calibration.

entry.title: Human-JEPA: A Human-Centric Vision Model that Perceives and Anticipates

author.name: Hui Wei, Licai Sun, Guoying Zhao

entry.summary: Human-JEPA trains a human-centric vision model on video via anchored forecasting, pinning dense targets to a frozen initialization copy to prevent dense-perception collapse, and leads pixel-anchored specialists on pose and person re-identification with 2.7x fewer parameters while gaining anticipation abilities.

entry.title: Decoupled Vision-Language System for Multimodal Understanding and Generation

author.name: Yifan Xu, Baochen Xiong, Xiaoshan Yang, Donglin Di, Yaowei Wang, Changsheng Xu

entry.summary: Libra is an MLLM architecture decoupling self-modal modeling from cross-modal interaction via switch attention and switch FFN modules that dynamically route computation, connected by cross-modal bridges between separate vision and language systems, evaluated in understanding-only and unified settings.

entry.title: TopoSurfel: Closing the Loop between Gaussian Surfels and Meshes for Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Chuanjin Fan, Wenjie Chang, Bohao Liao, Yujia Chen, Wenfei Yang, Tianzhu Zhang

entry.summary: TopoSurfel closes the loop between Gaussian surfels and continuous meshes for surface reconstruction, injecting explicit topological-geometric priors into 3DGS optimization to resolve structural ambiguities and artifacts in textureless or occluded regions.

entry.title: Routing Before Looking: Query-Adaptive Evidence Acquisition for Long-form Video Understanding

author.name: Tianyue Wang, Xuying Wu, Yuxiang Ma, Ruiming Liang, Jiaxuan Kang, Yanchao Hao, Zheng Wei, Leigang Qu, Haiyun Guo, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: Route2Look provides query-adaptive evidence acquisition for long-form video understanding via a Route-Look-Memorize loop selecting among global browsing, temporal grounding, and semantic retrieval based on query demands, replacing single-strategy pipelines.

entry.title: GAP-SAM: A Global Artifact Prior for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Manipulation Localization

author.name: Haozhen Yan, Siyuan Shan, Zijian Yu, Youqi Wang, Yan Hong, Jun Lan, Jianfu Zhang

entry.summary: GAP-SAM improves out-of-distribution AI-manipulation localization by constructing COCO-ControlNet alignment data, identifying boundary-adhesion failure modes in fine-tuned segmenters, and introducing a global artifact prior to disentangle forensic evidence from mask geometry.

entry.title: When does fusing hand-crafted knowledge with learned representations pay? A cost-normalized benchmark of stacking, substitution, and interference

author.name: Ahmad AlMughrabi, Albert Clop, Benjamin Busam, Ricardo Marques, Petia Radeva

entry.summary: A cost-normalized mega-benchmark (13 datasets, 9 backbones, hundreds of configurations) asking when fusing hand-crafted knowledge with learned representations helps, is redundant, or harms, comparing a pinned Gabor-target bank against SimCLR/DINO/ImageNet alternatives under a frozen recipe.

entry.title: Koala Gripper: Co-designing Robotic Grippers and Data-Capture Devices for Scaling Dexterous Manipulation Learning

author.name: Amar Hajj-Ahmad, Zubin Kremer Guha, Tim Fofonoff, Zhi Ern Teoh, Ciar\'an T. O'Neill, Ben Thacher, Igor Fala, Vidullan Surendran, Murphy Wonsick, Peter Whitney, David Watkins

entry.summary: The Koala Gripper paper presents a co-design framework for simultaneously developing handheld data-capture devices and robotic grippers, arguing that matching existing gripper morphologies sacrifices ergonomics and performance. The resulting system improves dexterity and grasp capability versus parallel-jaw grippers while remaining scalable for large-scale manipulation dataset collection.

entry.title: Volumetric Radiology AI in the Era of Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Zanting Ye, Shengyuan Liu, Xin Liu, Chenhui Wang, Zhisong Wang, Jiashuai Liu, Zipei Wang, Cheng Wang, Wentao Pan, Mengjie Fang, Di Dong, Mohammad Salmanpour, Arman Rahmim, Yu Gu, Yong Xia, Hongming Shan, Yixuan Yuan, Yefeng Zheng, Lijun Lu

entry.summary: Reviews how multimodal LLMs extend radiology AI beyond task-specific analysis while highlighting the representational mismatch between clinical volumetric 3D interpretation needs and 2D-image-conditioned MLLMs. It lays out requirements for representations preserving task-relevant 3D information and verifiable integration across clinical workflows.

entry.title: Ansari: A Retrieval-Grounded Islamic AI Assistant -- Architecture, Deployment, and Lessons from 140,000 Conversations

author.name: M Waleed Kadous, Amr Elsayed, Abdullah Al Nahas, Ashraf Haress

entry.summary: Ansari is a deployed retrieval-grounded Islamic AI assistant handling 140,000+ conversations in 25+ languages, answering only from authenticated corpora with citations to prevent fabricated verses and hadith, offering rare deployment lessons for high-stakes religious QA.

entry.title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Lauren Pothuru

entry.summary: AgenticRAG-FP is an interventional benchmark injecting certified faults at specified hops in three-hop MuSiQue retrieval trajectories to test whether post-hoc traces still localize the causal origin after downstream suffixes change, reporting coverage-based diagnosis results with Claude Haiku 4.5.

entry.title: Provable Edge-of-Stability for Adam on a One-Dimensional Quadratic

author.name: Yiman Fong, Heng Yang

entry.summary: Proves restoring behavior of uncorrected Adam toward a frozen stability threshold on one-dimensional quadratics, characterizing the full parameter-space dynamics including subcritical periodic orbits and supercritical convergence paths where edge-seeking breaks down.

entry.title: Tydra: An Efficient Hybrid Model for Tabular Data

author.name: Mieszko Komisarczyk, Saurabh Mathur, Maurice Kraus, Sriraam Natarajan, Kristian Kersting

entry.summary: Tydra interleaves attention and state-space-model layers for tabular in-context learning, cutting inference time about 30% versus TabPFN while retaining most predictive performance, and beats a roughly ten-times-larger Hydra model across 30 OpenML datasets.

entry.title: Minimax Optimality of Score-Entropy Discrete Diffusion

author.name: Cholyeon Cho, Yuchen Wu

entry.summary: Establishes minimax-optimal estimation rates for score-entropy discrete diffusion (SEDD), shifting analysis from sampling efficiency under small score error to finite-sample properties of score estimation itself.

entry.title: PerturbRx: Learning Treatment-Conditioned Latent Transitions for Patient Drug Response Prediction

author.name: Yoshitaka Inoue, Minoh Jeong, Alfred Hero, Rui Kuang, Augustin Luna

entry.summary: PerturbRx learns drug- and dose-conditioned latent molecular transitions from unpaired control/treated single-cell populations, freezing and applying them to pretreatment patient profiles to build patient-drug response features without post-treatment measurements.

entry.title: Beyond Raw Transcripts: Structured Persona Extraction for LLM-Based Digital Twins

author.name: Iris Ye, Tianze Deng, Ozan Candogan

entry.summary: Argues the bottleneck in LLM digital twins is structural organization of persona information rather than information volume, comparing unstructured summaries with newly introduced structured persona representations for simulating individual behavior on novel questions.

entry.title: RECOUNT: Reference-guided Counting with Synthetic Visual Exemplars

author.name: Adriano D'Alessandro, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Ghassan Hamarneh

entry.summary: RECOUNT enables image-guided zero-shot counting by specifying target categories visually from a single off-scene reference image, augmenting coverage with repurposed synthetic exemplars to handle diverse appearances and distractors.

entry.title: DiGS-Avatar: Single-Image Animatable 3D Human Reconstruction via UV-Space Diffusion

author.name: Jiakun Li, Li Fang, Hao Zhu, Fei Hu, Long Ye, Yuan Zhang, Jinyao Yan

entry.summary: DiGS-Avatar reformulates single-image animatable 3D human reconstruction as UV-latent completion with a teacher-student diffusion setup, ensuring 3D consistency by design while avoiding expensive and view-inconsistent multi-view synthesis stages.

entry.title: LHMCF-Net: A Learned Hyperbolic Mean Curvature Flow Network for Medical Images Segmentation

author.name: Shuangshuang Duan, Chunlei He, Shoujun Huang, Dexing Kong

entry.summary: LHMCF-Net grounds medical image segmentation in a learned hyperbolic mean curvature flow, a second-order dissipative PDE whose velocity-field inertia lets contours bypass noise-induced minima, unifying data fidelity and deep structural priors in one framework.

entry.title: When Adaptation Hurts: Connecting Representational Drift to OOD Failures in MedSAM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Marko Haralovi\'c, Sounic Akkaraju, Carlo Baretta, Vasil Zapryanov, Alexia Briassouli

entry.summary: Systematically examines MedSAM generalization across medical benchmarks under six adaptation strategies (LoRA variants, VPT, fine-tuning), trained on ISIC 2018 and tested under clean and noisy prompts on in- and out-of-distribution sets, linking representational drift to OOD failures.

entry.title: FF-MPCC: High-speed Agile Formation Flight with Model Predictive Contouring Control

author.name: Aditya Dandwate, Vit Kratky, Parakh M. Gupta, Martin Saska, Robert Penicka

entry.summary: FF-MPCC presents a decentralized formation-flight approach integrating formation maintenance into Model Predictive Contouring Control, introducing reparameterization and synchronization methods for dynamic formation geometries so each UAV adapts its path progression under individual dynamic constraints. It targets agile flight at platform limits along demanding trajectories.

entry.title: SDAD: Spec-Driven Agentic Development for the AI-Native SDLC

author.name: Vu Hung Nguyen, Thanh Nguyen

entry.summary: Formalizes Spec-Driven Agentic Development (SDAD), a workflow combining machine-readable specification, agentic synthesis, and multi-agent verification under human sign-off for AI-native software development. It argues that specification quality is becoming the key bottleneck as frontier coding agents ingest full requirement documents and repository context.

entry.title: Unified Branch-and-Bound Search for the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem on Graphs of Convex Sets

author.name: Jingtao Tang, Hang Ma

entry.summary: Formalizes the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem on Graphs of Convex Sets and develops a unified branch-and-bound search with additive lower-bound costs and cut-separated connected-flow relaxations. Proves finite termination guarantees for best-first traversal under uniform positive costs.

entry.title: The Divergence Hypothesis: Unmasking Lexical Interference and Label Bias in Mental Health NLP

author.name: Moustafa Yehia Hassan

entry.summary: Introduces TSS, a triple-stream probe decomposing text into lexical, morpho-syntactic, and psycholinguistic channels, revealing a lexical interference effect where adding lexical features hurts human-labeled but not auto-labeled mental-health classifiers. Proposes Degree of Divergence as a distribution-shift diagnostic adapted from epidemiology.

entry.title: ASTAR: Automated induction of STAndardized radiology Reporting templates from large-scale clinical free-text corpora

author.name: Xinfeng Zhang, Mingxuan Liu, Yifei Chen, Juncheng Zhu, Kasidit Anmahapong, Yiming Huang, Yuan Zhang, Hongjia Yang, Yi Liao, Gang Ning, Haibo Qu, Qiyuan Tian

entry.summary: ASTAR automates induction of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical free-text corpora using LLMs, removing the manual expert-consensus bottleneck that precedes information extraction in structured reporting pipelines.

entry.title: An integrated diffusion-weighted imaging processing and interpretation platform for MR-guided radiotherapy

author.name: Yunxiang Li, Yan Dai, Yen-Peng Liao, Jie Deng, Jill B De Vis, You Zhang

entry.summary: Web-based platform carrying raw MR-Linac diffusion-weighted imaging through distortion correction and quantitative processing to literature-grounded RAG-based clinical interpretation, evaluated by independent expert rating for radiotherapy guidance.

entry.title: One Hierarchy, Two Systems: Semantic Product IDs for Discovery-Surface Ranking and Search-Page Query Reformulation

author.name: Steven Xu, Sanjyot Thete, Saathvik Dirisala, Raghav Saboo, Nimesh Sinha, Leo Shao, Elyse Winer, Sudeep Das, Martin Wang, Kyle MacDonald

entry.summary: Shows a single hierarchical Semantic Product ID learned from product-content embeddings can jointly power discovery-surface ranking and search-page query reformulation across merchant-fragmented catalogs, aggregating behavioral evidence at hierarchy prefixes.

entry.title: Profiling What Matters: Context-Aware Item Profiles from Large-Scale Metadata for LLM Recommenders

author.name: Dojun Hwang, Seunghan Lee, Cheonyoung Park, Sara Yu, SeongKu Kang

entry.summary: CAIRO builds user context-aware item profiles from large-scale heterogeneous metadata and reviews for LLM-based reranking, structuring raw text and selecting salience dynamically across users rather than relying on titles or static summaries.

entry.title: Structured but Fragile: On the Limits of LLMs in Cybersecurity Decision-Making

author.name: Pasquale Malacaria, Yunxiao Zhang

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs perform structured security reasoning or rely on superficial cues by testing defence selection over attack graphs from real-world threat scenarios under budget constraints, comparing against game-theoretic optimization baselines. Finds conditional competence with fragile structure exploitation.

entry.title: FlatLand: Personalized Graph Federated Learning via Tailored Lorentz Space

author.name: Jiahong Liu, Ram Samarth B B, Xinyu Fu, Menglin Yang, Weixi Zhang, Rex Ying, Irwin King

entry.summary: FlatLand personalizes federated learning for structurally heterogeneous graphs by embedding each client's data in tailored Lorentz (hyperbolic) spaces, using the time-like dimension to encode client-specific heterogeneity. Targets the mismatch between Euclidean PFL methods and negatively curved graph structures.

entry.title: Learning Prostate Anatomy at Test Time for Cancer Detection in Micro-Ultrasound

author.name: Obed Korshie Dzikunu, Mohammad Mahdi Abootorabi, Mohamed Harmanani, Paul F. R. Wilson, Emma Willis, Ferdinand Luger, Adam Kinnaird, Brian Wodlinger, Parvin Mousavi, Purang Abolmaesumi

entry.summary: ANT adapts pretrained prostate cancer detectors to new imaging centers at test time by solving an auxiliary segmentation task supervised by pseudo-masks from a frozen segmentation network, aligning encoder representations to target anatomy rather than only correcting appearance statistics.

entry.title: COMET: Contrastive Motion-Enhanced Temporal Reasoning for Video Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Chenghua Zhu, Zhaolu Kang, Qifan Shi, Siyan Wu, Kehan Jiang, Lei Wei, Lianyu Hu, Guangyuan Dong, Mingbo Yang, Rui Lu, Guibo Luo

entry.summary: COMET strengthens video multimodal LLMs for motion-temporal understanding through explicit Taylor frame-difference motion branches, temporal attention fusion into the appearance stream, and direction-aware optimization targeting frame-to-frame change sensitivity.

entry.title: The Exceedance Design Effect: Effective Sample Size for Thresholds under Clustering

author.name: Adam Noonan

entry.summary: Defines an exceedance design effect importing survey-statistics effective-sample-size corrections to threshold-setting in ML pipelines, showing that clustered calibration examples (shared prompts, documents, traces) invalidate nominal coverage of conformal cutoffs, abstention gates, and safety filters.

entry.title: Tree-of-Concerns: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Debate for Unstated-Limitation Extraction in Scientific Critique

author.name: Sahil Mishra, Niranjan Rajeev, Tanmoy Chakraborty

entry.summary: Tree-of-Concerns deploys skeptic personas in parallel category-lens debate trees with a panel-review re-evaluation mechanism to extract unstated limitations from scientific papers, accompanied by ToC-Bench of 414 papers with 1,905 annotated unstated limitations.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Color Image Manipulation Localization via Noise Residual Artifact Pattern Analysis

author.name: Edgar Gonzalez-Fernandez

entry.summary: A zero-shot, training-free pipeline localizes image manipulations by estimating a device-specific reference artifact pattern from the noise residual of a single suspect image, exploiting full color-channel demosaicing correlations instead of green-channel-only residuals.

entry.title: A Collaborative Multi-Modality Interaction for VLA-based End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jingtao Sun, Xiaohai He, Yike Zhang, Dong Huang, Yaonan Wang, Ajmal Mian, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Proposes a VLA-based end-to-end autonomous driving system with collaborative multi-modality interaction across heterogeneous sensors, multi-trajectory planning, and optimized interpretable reasoning rather than pure visual-question-answering formulations.

entry.title: EmotionDialogCN: A Spontaneous Multimodal Dataset for Mandarin Emotional Dialogue

author.name: Yi Zheng, Yifan Xu, Yan Zhou, Hejia Chen, Chunyu Qiang, Xiaoqiang Liu, Xiaohan Li, Shenze Huang, Yue Zhang, Guoying Zhao, Pengfei Wan

entry.summary: EmotionDialogCN is a large-scale Mandarin audiovisual emotional dialogue dataset: 21,880 sessions, 119 professional actors, 18 emotion categories, over 400 hours, with a collection framework minimizing equipment interference for natural expression.

entry.title: Triangulation-Free Bundle Adjustment with Graduated Non-Convexity for Camera Pose Refinement from Coarse Priors

author.name: Nikolaos Kyriazis

entry.summary: Single-author paper showing COLMAP triangulation plus prior-seeded bundle adjustment consistently degrades accurate ARKit poses on ScanNet++ iPhone captures, then removes triangulation entirely with per-keypoint ray depths and graduated non-convexity for CPU-friendly pose refinement.

entry.title: Stream3Dv2: Geometric-Semantic Fusion Enhanced Streaming Zero-Shot 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Jie Xu, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Stream3Dv2 is a training-free framework for zero-shot streaming 3D scene understanding from RGB-D sequences, using nested local-to-historical processing for multi-view consistency with reduced overhead plus mechanisms to resist noisy 2D segmentation masks.

entry.title: The Coastline as a Structural Constraint: Harnessing Scene Geometry for Autonomous Surface Vessel Localization

author.name: Derek R. Benham, Joshua G. Mangelson

entry.summary: This paper presents two complementary frameworks for GPS-denied localization of autonomous surface vessels using coastal scene geometry. One uses LiDAR water-surface observations to estimate roll, pitch, and heave while registering shoreline observations against satellite-derived coastline maps; the other relies purely on passive imagery and semantic segmentation to detect shoreline and horizon. It demonstrates how largely unexploited geometric structure in coastal environments can provide globally referenced positioning cues.

entry.title: ExpertIVS: Sociological Expert Driven Individual Value Simulation in Large Language Models

author.name: Zhen Wang, Yuqi Ren, Yuehan Cui, Hongxiang Wang, Jianxiang Peng, Zhaoxia Zhang, Bingkun Zhu, Tongxuan Zhang, Dezhi Tong, Deyi Xiong

entry.summary: ExpertIVS employs fourteen sociological expert agents to interpret World Values Survey responses through structured professional perspectives rather than naive prompt concatenation, improving individual value-system simulation in LLM social agents and enabling dialogue-based rather than multiple-choice assessment.

entry.title: Toward Auto-Research: Mining Falsifiable Research Ideas from Paper Knowledge Graphs with Categorical Structure

author.name: Yuchen Wang, Zhongzhi Luan

entry.summary: Models research papers as typed categorical structures with composition and identity arrows so proposed cross-domain analogies must preserve relation chains when mining falsifiable research ideas from paper knowledge graphs, moving beyond free-text recombination in automated ideation.

entry.title: Approximate Homomorphisms and Convergent Representations in Transducers

author.name: Santiago Cifuentes

entry.summary: Studies stability of minimal representations (transducers) of controlled stochastic processes under perturbation, introducing approximate homomorphism notions and interface metrics motivated by predictive-state structure found in neural latents, with composability results and separation examples.

entry.title: C-Score: Beyond Accuracy for Robustness Assessment in Semi-Supervised Learning under Open-World Unlabeled Contamination

author.name: Tsao-Lun Chen, Chi-Cheng Fu, Han-Yi E. Chou, Shun-Feng Su

entry.summary: Proposes C-Score to detect hidden collapse in pseudo-label semi-supervised learning under open-world unlabeled contamination, where clean test accuracy stays stable even as internal learning dynamics deteriorate due to confident mislabeled OOD samples.

entry.title: CubicSplat: Differentiable Vector Graphics via Error-Bounded Forward Relaxation

author.name: Chenglong Liu, Xin Zhang, Yimeng Zhu, Liyang He, Yixiao Ma, Yu Su, Zhenya Huang, Qi Liu

entry.summary: CubicSplat is a differentiable vector rasterizer replacing Bezier closest-point solvers with error-bounded uniform polyline surrogates, diagnosing a gradient seesaw where forward exactness degrades gradient quality, and navigating this tension for editable resolution-independent graphics.

entry.title: AGIDefect-4K: A Richly Annotated Dataset for AI-Generated Image Defect Detection, Localization and Explanation
